[H] Ahmed Khames
[H] Junior Flutter Developer
[H] Alexandria, Egypt | +201276898296
[H] ahmedkham1234567@gmail.com | https://www.linkedin.com/in/ahmed-khames |
[H] https://github.com/Ahmed-Khames2
[H] Objective
Aspiring Junior Flutter Developer and final-year Computer Science student with hands-on experience building realworld applications. Skilled in Flutter, Firebase, REST APIs, and responsive UI design. Built and deployed production-
level apps that improved usability and performance. Eager to contribute to impactful mobile solutions and grow within a
collaborative development team. Completed multiple real-world projects with production-level features despite being in
an early career stage.
[H] Education
Faculty of Computer Science and Information – Kafr El-Sheikh University
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science
Oct 2022 – Present
Expected Graduation: June 2026
Current GPA: 3.4 / 4.0
[H] Experience
AI Prompt Trainer (Freelance) | Oct 2024 – Dec 2024
Outlier AI - Remote
- Trained AI models to better understand and respond to user prompts by evaluating outputs, reviewing over 200+
prompts weekly.
- Provided human feedback to enhance LLM performance and language accuracy, contributing to an estimated 15%
improvement in prompt-response alignment.
Cross-Platform Mobile App Developer Intern Jul 2025 – Present
DEPI – Remote
- Soft Skills: Improved teamwork, communication, and presentation skills through collaborative projects and freelance
coaching sessions, participating in 2+ team-based tasks and presenting progress in weekly reviews.
- Technical Skills: Built cross-platform mobile apps using Flutter, with focus on API integration, Firebase, and
responsive UI design, resulting in a 30% reduction in front-end issues during testing.
Volunteer Mobile App Developer | Jun 2025 – Present
Kafr El-Sheikh University – Faculty Project

Collaborating with a student team to develop a quality management mobile app using Flutter. Contributing to UI
design, code structure, and progress presentations during meetings.
GitHub: github.com/Malak308/Quality_Management
[H] Skills & abilities
Technical Skills
Flutter · Dart · Firebase · REST APIs · JSON · Git & GitHub · UI/UX · Responsive Design · Agile Development ·
Version Control · State Management (Bloc, Cubit, Provider) · MVVM · Clean Architecture · DB(SharedPreferences ,
Firebase Firestore , Local Storage)
Soft Skills
Teamwork · Communication Skills · Self-Motivation · Presentation · Time Management · Remote Collaboration ·
Adaptability · Team Leadership
[H] Projects
AlQuds App
An offline Islamic mobile app offering complete Azkar sections, full Quran without internet, prayer times based on
governorates in Egypt, and a dual Hijri/Gregorian calendar with Islamic and national events. Also includes 99 Names
of Allah with descriptions, a customizable digital tasbeeh, and a welcoming audio reminder to send blessings upon the
Prophet .ﷺ The app supports both light and dark themes with a fully custom UI.
Download: drive.google.com/ALQudes App
Technologies: Flutter · Bloc · SharedPreferences · JSON · Responsive Design · Feature-Based Architecture
Tawseela App
A ride-booking app designed for university students to book intercity and short-distance trips. The app supports realtime ride tracking, passenger and driver management, and a seamless booking experience. It also features OTP-
based authentication and a structured registration process.
GitHub: github.com/interesta22/Tawseela-App.git
Technologies: Flutter · Firebase · OpenStreetMap API · OTP Authentication · Clean Architecture
[H] Certifications
Flutter & Development Course
Instructor: Sarwat Samy – Udemy · Fep2024
Certificate: udemy.com/certificate
Flutter Advanced Course: Bloc and MVVM Pattern
Instructor: Sarwat Samy – Udemy · July 2025
Certificate: udemy.com/certificate
